rows.value: This brochure is the official statement of benefits.
rows.basis: document authority
rows.quote: This brochure is the official statement of benefits. No oral statement can modify or otherwise affect the benefits, limitations, and exclusions of this brochure.
rows.notes: Standard FEDVIP brochure language; returned verbatim by the fetch.

rows.basis: plan year 2026
rows.quote: If you sign up for a dental and/or vision plan during the 2025 Open Season, your coverage will begin on January 1, 2026.

rows.basis: benefit period definition
rows.quote: A period that starts on any January 1 and ends on the next December 31.
rows.section: Section 4 Your costs for covered services (Calendar year / Plan year)
rows.notes: One fetch placed this sentence on p. 21, another on p. 23. A second sentence was returned from p. 23: "The calendar year refers to the plan year, which is defined as January 1, 2026, to December 31, 2026."

rows.value: Federal employees and annuitants eligible for FEDVIP; nationwide and overseas
rows.basis: who may enroll
rows.quote: All Federal employees and annuitants in the United States and overseas who are eligible to enroll in Federal Employees Dental and Vision Insurance Program.
rows.notes: Cover also prints "A Nationwide Dental PPO Plan" and "MetLife Dental is available nationwide and overseas." Listed here means the document is public — not that a given user is eligible to enroll.

rows.basis: per class
rows.page_label: page not determinable from the text extraction
rows.notes: Two independent searches of the extracted text found no sentence containing "waiting". Because the extraction was truncated, the absence cannot be asserted as 'no waiting periods'.

rows.basis: every 12 months; periodic (D0120) and comprehensive (D0150) evaluations are combined under one limitation
rows.quote: Periodic oral evaluation - established patient - Limited to 2 every 12 months
rows.notes: Also: "Comprehensive oral evaluation - new or established patient - Limited to 2 every 12 months" (D0150) and "D0140 Limited oral evaluation - problem focused is not combined with other examinations and has a separate frequency of one every 12 months" (single fetch). One fetch gave the Class A table range as pp. 25–28.

rows.basis: in 12 months; High Option only adds a third cleaning paired with pregnancy or diabetes (1 in 12 months)
rows.quote: Prophylaxis – adult - Limited to 2 in 12 months; High Option only: a third cleaning
rows.notes: Longer form returned by one fetch: "...a third cleaning covered when paired with pregnancy or diabetes at limitation of 1 in 12 months". Child row: "Prophylaxis – child - Limited to 2 in 12 months" (D1120).

rows.basis: set every calendar year (adult); children 1 set every 6 months
rows.quote: Bitewings - four radiographic images - Adult - 1 set every calendar year
rows.notes: Row continues "/Children - 1 set every 6 months". Same limitation printed for D0270, D0272, D0277; D0273 listed without limitation text in returned output.

rows.basis: every 12 months for dependent children based on age limits (age limit itself not printed in returned text)
rows.quote: Topical application of fluoride – excluding varnish - Limited to 2 every 12 months
rows.notes: Row continues "for dependent children based on age limits". Varnish row: "Topical application of fluoride varnish - Limited to 1 in 12 months for adults, 2 every 12 months for dependent children based on age limits" (D1206). The dependent-child age cutoff was not returned — UNKNOWN.

rows.basis: per tooth every 36 months; unrestored permanent molars; less than age 19
rows.quote: Sealant - per tooth - Limited to unrestored permanent molars - Less than age 19
rows.notes: Row continues ". 1 sealant per tooth every 36 months".

rows.basis: replacement restoration per 24 months (applies to fillings generally — amalgam and composite)
rows.quote: Replacement restorations (fillings) are limited to 1 in 24 months.
rows.notes: Single fetch. Posterior composite rows (D2391–D2394) are listed in Class B with no separate amalgam-allowance wording in returned text; the class note reads "A number of the services listed in this section may be subject to Dental Review or an Alternate Benefit may be paid" (p. 29).

rows.basis: D7140 and D7210 both listed in Class B
rows.quote: D7210 Extraction, erupted tooth requiring removal of bone and/or sectioning of tooth
rows.notes: Two fetches agree on p. 31. Simple extraction row: "D7140 Extraction, erupted tooth or exposed root (elevation and/or forceps removal)". No frequency limitation text returned for extractions.

rows.basis: per quadrant every 24 months (D4341 four or more teeth per quadrant; D4342 one to three teeth per quadrant)
rows.quote: Periodontal scaling and root planing - four or more teeth per quadrant – Limited to 1 every 24 months
rows.notes: One fetch placed D4341/D4342 on p. 31, another on p. 30. Class B membership (High in-network you pay 30%).

rows.notes: Two verification calls reported D3330 NOT PRESENT in the extracted text; only pulpotomy/pulpal therapy codes (D3220, D3222, D3230, D3240, D3355–D3357) appeared in Class B. Likely a text-extraction truncation; open the PDF directly to confirm class and coinsurance for molar root canal.

rows.quote: D2740 Crown - porcelain/ceramic - Limited to 1 per tooth every 60 months
rows.notes: Returned identically by four fetches with footer p. 33.

rows.notes: Also printed: "D2791 Crown - full cast predominantly base metal – Limited to 1 per tooth every 60 months", "D2792 Crown - full cast noble metal – Limited to 1 per tooth every 60 months", "D2750 Crown - porcelain fused to high noble metal - Limited to 1 per tooth every 60 months", "D2950 Core buildup, including any pins when required – Limited to 1 per tooth every 60 months".

rows.page_label: page not determinable from the text extraction
rows.section: searched for D5211–D5214 in Class C
rows.notes: Verification call: D5110, D5120, D5211–D5214 NOT PRESENT in extracted text. Only denture adjustment/repair/rebase/reline codes were visible (Class B, p. 31; e.g., "D5710 Rebase complete maxillary denture - Limited to 1 in a 36-month period"). An earlier call's rows ("D5211 Complete denture – maxillary – Limited to 1 every 60 months", p. 35) do not match CDT descriptors and were discarded as unreliable.

rows.quote: D6049 Scaling and debridement of a single implant in the presence of peri-implantitis
rows.section: Section 2 — How we have changed for 2026 (new codes added)
rows.notes: Implant body (D6010) row NOT PRESENT in two verification calls; coverage status and limits for implant placement are unknown from extracted text. Only implant maintenance codes (D6049, D6280) appeared, in the 2026 changes list.

rows.basis: in 24 months (changed for 2026 from 1 in 12 months); class and coinsurance not returned
rows.quote: Changing the frequency limitation of occlusal guards from 1 in 12 months to 1 in 24 months
rows.section: Section 2 — How we have changed for 2026
rows.notes: Single fetch. Codes D9944–D9946/D9940 NOT PRESENT in extracted text; related new code: "D9936 Cleaning and inspection of occlusal guard – per appliance (General Services)" (p. 6).

rows.basis: less costly covered service producing a professionally acceptable result
rows.quote: we will pay benefits based upon the less costly service if such service would produce a professionally acceptable result under generally accepted dental standards
rows.notes: Opening of the clause: "If MetLife determines that a less costly covered service other than the covered service the dentist performed could have been performed to treat a dental condition". Follow-on sentence (p. 18): "If we pay benefits based upon a less costly service in accordance with this section the Dentist may charge you or your dependent for the difference between the service that was performed and the less costly service." Footer p. 18 verified.

rows.basis: prior services count toward frequency/replacement limits
rows.quote: the date of the prior service may be counted toward the time, frequency limitations and/ or replacement limitations under this dental insurance.
rows.notes: Full sentence begins: "When dental services that are subject to a frequency limitation were performed prior to your effective date of coverage". Two fetches agree.

rows.page_label: page not determinable from the text extraction
rows.notes: "missing" appears only in denture repair codes (e.g., "D5520 Replace missing or broken teeth – complete denture – per tooth", p. 31). No missing-tooth exclusion found in the extracted text; Section 7 General Exclusions (p. 50) was not reliably extracted.

rows.value: Out-of-Network Plan Allowance equals the In-Network Plan Allowance; member pays amounts above the Plan Allowance
rows.basis: Plan Allowance
rows.quote: The Plan Allowance for Out-of-Network services will be equal to the In-Network Plan Allowance for the covered service
rows.notes: Two fetches agree. Balance billing (p. 17): "Out-of-Network providers may charge their normal fees which may be greater than the Plan Allowance." and "you are responsible for the difference between the Plan Allowance and our payment plus the difference between the amount the provider bills and the Plan Allowance."

rows.basis: in-network member cost
rows.quote: for In-Network services you only pay the difference between the Plan Allowance for the covered service and the plan's benefit payment
rows.notes: Sentence continues "subject to any deductibles and benefits maximums." Single fetch; no explicit 'accepts as payment in full' wording was found.

rows.basis: definition
rows.quote: The maximum amount we will consider for payment for a specific procedure. The actual benefit will be a percentage of the plan allowance.
rows.section: Section 9 — Definitions of terms — Plan Allowance
rows.notes: Returned by one fetch with footer p. 59; a later fetch said the Definitions section was not visible in its text window. Verify in the PDF before use.
